_concepto: Tercer loop ambiente (11/9/2026). Un pequeño módulo-invernadero en órbita: bandejas de plantas bajo luz magenta de cultivo, y por un gran ojo de buey la Tierra girando despacio. Doce encuadres, cámara fija, un movimiento lento por plano. Lecciones aplicadas: negativos:false, primeros planos de objeto, nada abstracto, ninguna silla vacía; la única ventana da al espacio, sin ciudad ni gente posible detrás. El bucle se cierra en el corte O12 → O01.
_planta: Módulo cilíndrico, paredes blancas y grises con paneles y cables; dos filas de bandejas hidropónicas con plantas verdes (tomate, frutilla, lechuga, hierbas) bajo tubos de luz magenta-violeta a lo largo; al fondo un gran ojo de buey circular con la Tierra azul llenándolo; a la izquierda una rejilla de ventilación con un ventilador pequeño; a la derecha una regadera metálica sujeta con velcro y un manojo de hierbas secas colgando.
estilo_imagen: Hand-painted 2D animation background art for a calm lo-fi music video set inside a small orbital greenhouse module: soft painterly brushwork, gentle film grain. Magenta and violet grow-light glow on green leaves against cool blue Earth-light coming through a big round porthole; white and grey panels, a few cables. Muted but rich palette: magenta, violet, leaf green, deep space blue. Clean readable shapes, soft edges. Everything is still and quiet, tiny dust motes float. Nobody anywhere in the picture. The painting fills the ENTIRE 16:9 canvas from edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no cinemascope strip, no borders or frames of any kind.
medio: hand-painted 2D animated film with soft painterly textures, calm, slow and quiet

modulo.descripcion: a small cylindrical orbital greenhouse module: two rows of hydroponic trays with green plants under magenta grow-light tubes, a big round porthole at the far end filled with the blue Earth, a vent grille with a small fan at the left, a metal watering can and a bundle of dried herbs at the right

madre.prompt: Hand-painted 2D animation background art, wide 16:9 landscape frame, calm lo-fi illustration style: soft painterly brushwork, gentle film grain. WIDE SHOT down the length of a small cylindrical orbital greenhouse module, seen from the hatch at one end. Two rows of white hydroponic trays full of green plants (tomato, strawberry, lettuce, herbs) run along both sides under long magenta-violet grow-light tubes that bathe the leaves in pink light. At the far end a BIG round porthole fills the wall, and through it the blue Earth with white swirls of cloud and a thin glowing atmosphere line, casting cool blue light into the module. On the LEFT wall a vent grille with a small fan. On the RIGHT a metal watering can held by a strap and a bundle of dried herbs hanging. White and grey panels, a few tidy cables, tiny dust motes in the light. Nobody in the module. No text, no letters, no labels, no screens anywhere. This is a single film frame, not a poster: no text, no borders, no titles, no watermark. The painting fills the ENTIRE 16:9 canvas from edge to edge: no black bars, no letterbox, no cinemascope strip, no borders or frames of any kind.

planos.funcion: ARRANQUE DEL BUCLE. El módulo entero desde la escotilla: las bandejas bajo luz magenta y la Tierra en el ojo de buey.
planos.ve: WIDE SHOT down the length of the greenhouse module from the hatch, the SAME view as the reference location picture: the two rows of trays with green plants under magenta grow lights, the big round porthole at the far end filled with the blue Earth and its clouds, the vent fan at the left, the watering can and dried herbs at the right, tiny dust motes floating in the light. Nobody in the module.
planos.mueve: LOCKED-OFF STATIC CAMERA, perfectly still for the whole shot. The only motion: the Earth in the porthole turns very slowly and its clouds drift, and one or two leaves sway very slightly. Everything else in the picture, including every light, is a still painting: nothing changes in brightness or colour from the first frame to the last.
planos.audio: [Ambient] The only sounds are a soft steady hum of ventilation, a faint electrical hum from the grow lights, and an occasional tiny drip of water.
